title: Cheese, Go Home!
author: C. "Sparky" Read
description: In this simple game you play Frankie, who has plans to go to the State Fair tonight with her friend Kathy. But Cheese has dropped by unexpectedly while you were preparing dinner...and he won't go home! Worse, old Mr. Herriman won't let you go to the Fair if Cheese is still in the house at dinnertime. Get rid of Cheese before then or it's no fair for you...literally.
